selection_subject: Choose the first producer row that consumes the shared compare reader's Var rhs SymbolRef output.

candidates.name: TopLevelIfVarRhsCondRecipeRow
candidates.reason: Top-level If is the narrowest producer: it can attach a SymbolRef BoolRecipe sidecar without loop route/release or body-shape semantics.

candidates.name: LoopNestedIfVarRhsCondRecipeRow
candidates.reason: Loop-body nested If still has multiple cond_rhs_int body-shape consumers; open it after the top-level If sidecar row proves the producer boundary.

candidates.name: TopLevelLoopVarRhsCondRecipeRow
candidates.reason: Top-level Loop condition feeds route-sensitive loop facts and existing cond_rhs_int route surfaces; it is not the first producer row.

candidates.name: LengthBoundProducerRows
candidates.reason: Length and length-minus bounds are not yet supported by the shared reader.

candidates.name: MutationBearingLoweringOwner
candidates.reason: MIR Compare/Branch emission remains deferred until producer rows and operand/materialization boundaries are stable.
